# Public Primitives Contract

Canonical enumeration of every primitive an extension author may rely on as stable. Symbols not listed are internal and may change without notice.

The manifest at `EXT.Contracts.json` is the source of truth. CI fails on drift between the manifest and `serverframework.__all__` (Item 68) and between this file and the manifest.
